historias: As administrative staff, I want to register the data of a new patient to admit them into the system.
As administrative staff, I want to edit the data of a registered patient to keep the information up to date.
As administrative staff, I want to record the patient's medical history in their electronic health record to understand their health status.
As administrative staff or medical staff, I want to search for a specific patient to manage appointments or review their medical history.
As administrative staff, I want to register an appointment to schedule the patient's medical care.
As administrative staff, I want to cancel an existing appointment to free up the schedule.
As administrative staff, I want to edit an existing appointment to change its date without losing information.
As a patient, I want to be notified when my appointment is modified or canceled to stay informed.
As a physician, I want to access the patient's electronic health record to review their previous information.
As a physician, I want to record the diagnosis made during the appointment to document the medical care provided.
As administrative staff, I want to register physicians with their specialties and schedules to enable appointment assignment.
As administrative staff, I want to edit the data of a registered physician to keep the information up to date.
As administrative staff, I want to deactivate a registered physician to keep the information up to date.
As administrative staff, I want to activate a registered physician to keep the information up to date.
As administrative staff, I want to define roles and permissions to control access to system functionalities.
As a patient, I want to have an invoice associated with a medical consultation as proof of payment.
As a patient, I want to have an invoice associated with a medication as proof of payment.
As a patient, I want to receive a notification when a charge is generated to access the invoice.
As a patient, I want to consult my electronic health record to access my medical information.
As a pharmacist, I want to register medications or supplies to keep the hospital inventory up to date.
As a pharmacist, I want to edit the quantity of available medications or supplies to keep the inventory updated.
As a pharmacist, I want to associate a medication with the patient who collected it so the system generates the corresponding invoice.
As a pharmacist, I want to check how many units of a medication or supply are available to make timely decisions.
As a pharmacist, I want to know when a medication or supply is close to expiration to make timely decisions.
As a pharmacist, I want to know when a medication or supply has a low stock level to make timely decisions.
As an analyst, I want to view statistics of consultations by specialty to assess workload.
As an analyst, I want to view financial reports of services to evaluate income and economic performance of the hospital.
As an analyst, I want to view supply consumption to evaluate inventory usage in the hospital.
As an administrative staff member, I want to register patients with personal data and medical background, so that the hospital can maintain accurate and complete patient records.
As an administrative staff member, I want to modify the personal and contact details of a registered patient, so that patient information remains up to date.
As an administrative staff member, I want to search for patients by name, identity document, or identifier number, so that I can quickly locate patient records.
As an authorized user, I want to visualize a patient's complete information, so that I can review all relevant details for care or administration.
As an administrative staff member, I want to create medical appointments by associating the patient, specialty, and professional, so that appointments are scheduled accurately.
As an administrative staff member, I want to visualize the availability of registered doctors, so that I can schedule appointments efficiently.
As an administrative staff member, I want to modify or cancel existing appointments, so that changes can be managed as needed.
As a patient, I want to receive notifications when my appointment is modified or canceled, so that I am always informed about my schedule.
As an administrative staff member, I want to manage the status of appointments throughout their lifecycle, so that the hospital can track appointment outcomes.
As a doctor, I want to register diagnoses, treatments, and patient’s clinical progress in the electronic clinical record, so that patient care is well documented.
As a patient, I want to consult my electronic clinical record, so that I can stay informed about my health history.
As an administrator, I want to register medical professionals with their personal and contact details and associate specialties, so that the hospital can manage staff information.
As an administrator, I want to define and modify attention hours and activate or deactivate professionals for scheduling, so that doctor availability is accurately reflected.
As an administrator, I want to manage roles and access permissions to system functionalities, so that users only access features relevant to their role.
As an administrative staff member, I want to generate electronic invoices for medical consultations and medication delivery, so that billing is accurate and efficient.
As a patient, I want to receive automatic notifications with attached digital invoices when an invoice is generated, so that I am promptly informed about charges.
As a pharmacist, I want to register medications and supplies with identification, stock, and expiration date, so that inventory is accurately tracked.
As a pharmacist, I want to automatically update stock when registering medication deliveries, so that inventory levels remain current.
As a pharmacist, I want to be notified when stock is low or items are about to expire, so that I can take timely action.
As a pharmacist, I want to consult inventory sorted by available quantity or expiration date, so that I can manage stock efficiently.

As an analyst, I want to generate reports on consultations by specialty, appointment status, financial income, and medication and supplies consumption, with date range filters, so that I can analyze hospital performance.
As a system administrator, I want to ensure date validations prevent invalid ranges, so that data integrity is maintained.
As a system administrator, I want to ensure notifications are sent within a reasonable time after triggering events, so that users are promptly informed.
